scenarios.name: bad_credentials
scenarios.doc: A token the API refuses shows the form again with `invalid_auth`; the same flow then takes the right one.

scenarios.name: cannot_connect
scenarios.doc: What the API's failures show: an error status, an error `statusCode` and a refused connection are `cannot_connect`; a body that isn't JSON or has no lists is `unknown`.

scenarios.name: duplicate
scenarios.doc: The account's token is the entry's unique id: a second flow with it aborts, one with another token makes a second entry.
